startError.past: The start date has already passed.
startError.soon: Pick a start from {from} on, so check-in can open first.

teamsReset.toDuel: When you save, teams are dissolved and {count, plural, one {the registered player plays} other {each of the # registered players plays}} solo.

admissionOptions.invite_only: Only by link or by organizers

checkInOffHint: All registered players enter the bracket.
checkInHint: Only players who confirm attendance on the site enter the bracket.
checkInOffHintTdm: All registered players can join a team.
checkInHintTdm: Only players who confirm attendance on the site can join a team.
contestHint: Time for the opponent to confirm or dispute the submitted game. Without a response, it counts.

translationHint: A blank description or rules show the original.
willDelete: The saved translation will be deleted when you save. To keep it, add the language again before saving.

veto.title: Maps

mapModeHint.veto: Before the first game, both sides ban and pick maps.
mapModeHint.vetoEven: Before the first game, both sides ban maps until {games} are left. Games follow the pool order.
mapModeHint.vote: For each game, each side votes for one of 3 maps drawn from the pool. If the votes differ, a draw picks between the two.
mapModeHint.random: The map is drawn from the pool, without repeating within the match.
mapModeHint.off: No map repeats within the match.

mapModeHintTdm.veto: Before the first game, teams ban and pick maps.
mapModeHintTdm.vetoEven: Before the first game, teams ban maps until {games} are left. Games follow the pool order.
mapModeHintTdm.vote: For each game, each team votes for one of 3 maps drawn from the pool. If the votes differ, a draw picks between the two.
mapModeHintTdm.random: The map is drawn from the pool, without repeating within the match.
mapModeHintTdm.off: No map repeats within the match.

veto.sequence: Best of {bestOf} with {maps, plural, one {# map} other {# maps}}: {steps}.
veto.mapPoolHint: The longest match needs at least {min, plural, one {# map} other {# maps}}.
veto.showPoolOut: Show {count, plural, one {the map} other {# maps}} out of pool
veto.secondsHint: If time runs out, the pick is drawn at random.
veto.secondsHintDraft: Also applies to champions. If time runs out, the pick is drawn at random.
veto.teamPickSecondsHint: Applies to the whole window, one champion per game. Whatever is missing at the end is drawn at random.

stageFormatHints.double: Whoever loses drops to the losers' bracket. Losing again eliminates them.
stageFormatHints.single: Whoever loses a match is out.
stageFormatHints.round_robin: Everyone plays every other participant once. Up to {max} participants.
stageFormatHints.swiss: Each round, players with the same score face each other, without repeating opponents. Up to {max} participants.
stageFormatHints.placement: Seeding sets the pairs (1st vs. 2nd, 3rd vs. 4th...). The winner takes the higher place. Up to {max} participants.

swissRoundsHint: Automatic: 3 rounds for up to 8 registered, 4 for up to 16, and 5 for up to 32. With few registered, at most one less than their number.
swissRoundsHintTdm: Automatic: 3 rounds for up to 8 teams, 4 for up to 16, and 5 for up to 32. With few teams, at most one less than their number.

championRules.bansHint: A banned champion is out for both sides.
championRules.bansOption: {count, plural, =0 {No bans} one {# per side} other {# per side}}

pickOrderHints.alternating: One at a time, alternating sides. The side that goes first switches each game.
pickOrderHints.blind: Everyone at the same time. What a side picks only shows when everyone finishes.
pickOrderHints.open: Everyone at the same time, seeing the others' picks.

championRules.pickOrderBlindNeedsMirror: Blind requires that opponents can use the same champion.
championRules.mirror: Opponents can use the same champion in the game
championRules.mirrorOff: The first to pick gets the champion.
championRules.sameTeam: Teammates can use the same champion in the game

otherGamesHints.stage: Counts only games played. Needs more champions, which limits slots and matches.
otherGamesHints.tournament: Counts only games played. Needs more champions, which limits slots and matches.

championRules.whoTeam: A player's champion is out for the whole team in other games.

admissionOpenHint: Any member can register until the start.

hints.captain: The captain vetoes, bans, picks champions for everyone and submits the result.
hints.balanced: The captain vetoes and bans. Each player picks their own champion. Anyone can submit the result.
hints.everyone: Any player can veto, ban and submit the result. Each picks their own champion.
